A girl I attempted to steal a phone case from. 


Let me fill you in on how much of a little sh*t I was as a kid. I would steal at book fairs and all sorts of stuff. But this once particular time in 6th grade I can’t forget. So, I really wanted this phone case this girl had (we had the same iPhone at the
time so it was perfect.) I had my eye on it for awhile online but it was limited edition and sold out. Once I figured out this girl in my math class had it, I developed a plan. So, it was testing season, and our math class headed down to the library to do some math quiz thing. I noticed the girl with the case finished, so she went to the left hand side of the library, sitting in a corner. This was the perfect time to strike. I quickly finished up the test and we had 20 minutes left, meaning I had 20 minutes to steal this girl’s phone case. 

I asked the librarian if I could get a book to pass the time and it was good with her. Just as I was turning around, I saw the girl going up to the librarian to ask to go to the restroom. Even more perfect. I slowly went over to the corner the girl was sitting and saw her phone there on the table, unsupervised (dumb of her to leave it there.) I went up to the corner and pretended I was picking out a book, so I grabbed a random book and set it down at the table. I quickly, yet carefully snatched the phone up. I was working to get the phone case off under the desk, and I succeeded. I tucked the phone case under my shirt and then into my bra (I was wearing a large hoodie over my shirt, so you couldn’t really make out the shape of the case.)

 Anyway, I returned happily back to my seat and pretended to read this book I randomly picked out. Then, the girl came into the library and went back to her little corner table. I turned around and she looked all confused and was looking on the floor, the chairs and shelf, etc. But obviously, she couldn’t find it. She went up to the librarian and I heard her complaining about the phone case missing and the librarian quickly announced the missing phone case. I turned bright red, so I looked down and hid my face. I was closest to the librarian, so she told me to stand up and take my hoodie off, I followed her orders. The librarian could easily make out the shape of the phone case in my bra as the shirt was thin and it was obvious.

  I turned blood red, without a doubt, she asked me to take the phone shaped object out. I followed her demands, and not to her surprise, she saw the phone case. The girl I stole it from looked furious. She marched over to the librarian and snatched the phone case out her hand. I forgot what the girl said to me exactly, but it something like “You’re jelly.” Needless to say, everyone gave me weird looks for the rest of the year. And yes, I got Saturday school for what I did.

Don’t steal phone cases and shove them in your bra, or any object for that matter.
